text: dsh-takeover 是面向 DSH Web 的会话与记忆接力插件。它通过 DSH 工具、斜杠技能和 Web 工作台，把外部 agent 的本地会话摘要带入当前会话，并将当前进度或记忆文件整理成 handoff: 1 卡片放入共享收件箱。主要功能包括浏览并接管九种 agent 会话、寄存当前会话、列出和领取待办卡片，以及扫描和打包常见记忆文件。适合在不同 agent 或设备间继续 AI 编码任务的 DSH 用户。需要 DSH 和 Node.js；可用 HANDOFF_HOME 指定卡片共享目录。

dsh-takeover helps DSH users continue work across agents. Its tools read local sessions from nine agent types, save progress as handoff cards, pick up inbox cards, and package common memory files. Requires DSH and Node.js; HANDOFF_HOME sets the card directory.
想把另一个编程 agent 没做完的会话接到 DSH 里继续。
DSH 能不能读取 Claude Code 或 Codex 的本地会话进度？

如何在两台电脑之间交接一个还没完成的编码任务？

能先浏览本机其他 AI 编程工具的会话，再挑一个接管吗？
I want to continue an unfinished coding session from another local agent inside DSH.
Can I save my current DSH progress and pick it up from an inbox later?
dsh-takeover 的功能「读取外部会话」：列出九种本地 agent 的会话候选，并按引用生成结构化摘要和交接素材。通过 foreign_session_read 工具调用，可按需分页查看原始轮次。
dsh-takeover 的功能「寄存会话进度」：把当前 DSH 会话的目标、文件、进展和后续工作等整理为 handoff: 1 卡片，写入共享收件箱；未提供的段落可从会话事件生成。调用 handoff_push 或使用 /handoff。
dsh-takeover 的功能「领取交接卡」：先列出待处理卡片，再按卡片 id 载入一张并归档，供当前会话继续工作。可调用 handoff_inbox 的 list、load 操作，或使用 /inbox。
dsh-takeover 的功能「交接 agent 记忆」：扫描常见的用户级或项目级记忆文件，显示来源清单，并可选择文件内容打包成收件箱卡片。通过 handoff_memory 工具的 scan、push 操作使用。
dsh-takeover 使用本机文件系统保存交接卡和开关配置；默认位于 ~/.handoff，可通过 HANDOFF_HOME 改到其他目录，因此跨设备共享需自行让该目录可访问。
@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Introduction：

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · dsh-takeover · 会话接管：**把任何 agent 干到一半的活接过来继续干——九家 CLI 会话只读拉取、一键寄存、开局取件，会话和记忆都能交接。**

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cold777/dsh-takeover)

- **接过来**：Claude Code 里干到一半的任务，`/resume-claude` 一条命令——六段交接卡注入当前会话，模型直接接着干；
- **交出去**：会话太长想换环境？`/handoff` 把当前会话寄存成一张卡，任何 agent 开局取件继续；
- **跨机器**：`HANDOFF_HOME` 指向同步盘，公司机器寄存、家里机器取件，手机上也能看卡。

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 30 秒上手：| 你想干什么 | 对 agent 说 / 敲 | 背后发生什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 接管别家会话 | `/resume-claude`（或自然语言："把 Claude Code 最新的会话接过来"） | 只读拉取 → 六段交接卡注入当前轮 → 模型接着干 |
| 交接当前会话 | `/handoff` | 当前会话蒸馏成协议卡寄存进共享收件箱，未提交改动自动附补丁 |
| 开局取件 | `/inbox` | 列出待取件 → 挑一张核验签收 → 上下文注入继续干 |
| 浏览了再接 | 点输入框工具行的「接力」按钮 | 浮出工作台：九家最近会话浏览、一键接管 / 交接出去、记忆快照 |
| 记忆一起交接 | 工作台 → 记忆快照 → 勾选打包 | CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md 等打包成卡，取件方按卡吸收进自己的记忆文件 |

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 它怎么工作（60 秒）：**文件系统即总线。** `~/.handoff/pending/` 一个卡片一个 `.md`：写入即投递，取件即移入 `archived/`（滚动保留 50 份；消费即弃，二次取件报错）。

**卡片 = Markdown + YAML frontmatter + 六段正文**（目标 / 涉及文件 / 做到哪 / 还差什么 / 停在哪 / 读者警告），带四态证据账本（CURRENT_OBSERVED / HISTORY_REPORTED / MISMATCH / UNAVAILABLE）——历史陈述不冒充当下事实；git 仓库的未提交改动自动随卡附补丁（≤512KB 拒带不截断）。

**信任长在文件里。** 首次寄存自动生成总线密钥，卡片带机器签名；取件侧三态裁决 `ok / tampered / no-key`，篡改可检出、跨信任域不误报。

**只读承诺。** 不写任何外部 agent 的会话库，不访问网络，不回放历史工具调用；原文不进卡片，卡里只有指针。

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 工具与命令参考：| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `foreign_session_read` | 只读拉取九家会话。`action=list` 列候选（标题/时间/轮数）；`action=show` 按引用（空/latest/id/前缀/路径/标题关键词，歧义返回候选不猜）返回结构化摘要：标题、轮数、首条请求、尾部进展、涉及文件 top15、六段卡素材。原文仅在显式传 `limit` 时分页给出；探测/解析失败返回 `{ ok: false, error }` 不抛 |
| `handoff_push` | 当前会话寄存为协议卡。六段文本可选传入，留空段从会话事件流确定性兜底（不调 LLM）；未提交改动自动附补丁；返回 `{ ok, id, path, coverage, patch? }` |
| `handoff_inbox` | `action=list` 列待取件；`action=load` 取件（消费即弃，附签名与 git 核验的 MISMATCH / UNAVAILABLE 警告） |
| `handoff_memory` | 记忆快照。`action=scan` 只读列各 agent 记忆文件（含大小/预览）；`action=push` 勾选打包成卡寄存，取件方按「建议加载」吸收 |

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 工具与命令参考：**slash 命令（用户敲，agent 按指引执行）**

| 命令 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `/resume-*`（九家） | 解析引用 → 只读拉取 → 四态标注（外来历史一律不可信、不覆盖当前指令）→ 六段卡注入当前轮 → 末尾问一句「要不要顺手寄存进收件箱」 |
| `/handoff` | 按协议语义六条（证据账本四态、原文不进卡、产物只引路径、redact、建议加载段、反向锚定+剪枝）把当前会话蒸馏成卡寄存 |
| `/inbox` | 列 pending 让用户挑；取件后注入当前轮，强调卡片是 HISTORY_REPORTED，执行前先核对 git 状态 |
@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 跨机器接力：`HANDOFF_HOME` 指向同步盘目录或 git 仓库，收件箱即多机共享：A 机 `handoff_push` 寄存，B 机开局 `/inbox` 取件。一句环境变量，零代码。同步盘里的卡片在手机文件查看器里同样可读。

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 质量与证据：接力质量不是感觉，是数字、测试与第三方可复核的证明（口径与复现步骤见 [eval/README.md](eval/README.md)）：

- **回测**：50 张真实交接卡回测延续率 34.7%；done 段带账本标注的卡延续率 50%、无标注 0%。端到端双卡接力真 host 真模型评测 PASS。
- **回归**：13 份 golden files 逐字节冻结真实会话脱敏语料，上游存储布局一变就红在提交前。
- **安全**：威胁模型见 [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md)；红队套件 8 组随 CI——密钥闸覆盖六段正文、全部标量与随卡补丁 diff。
- **协议**：`conformance/` 可执行套件（MUST 9 条推导自 SPEC）；参考实现与「只读 SPEC 从零手写」的独立第二实现双双符合。
- **互通**：INTERCHANGE v1（dsh-chat-import）↔ handoff: 1 双向转换，转换产物经对方插件 v0.26.2 真实导入互验。

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 定位：AI 编码的「延续上下文」需求由三层各管一段：spec 工具（spec-kit / OpenSpec 一类）管**设计态**——要做什么、验收是什么；记忆层（mem0 / Letta / dsh-hippo 一类）管**偏好态**——项目约定与对话事实的沉淀；dsh-takeover 管**运行态**——实际跑到哪、停在哪、哪些陈述是当下观察、哪些只是历史转述、卡出自哪台机器。三层互补，不互相替代。

同类机制的一句话区分：**他们做「转换后换一家 CLI 原生续跑」「跨设备同步」「导航搜索」「运行时编排」或「任务状态搬运」，我们做 harness 内接管。**

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 协议采用：`handoff: 1` 是开放协议：六段 Markdown 卡 + YAML frontmatter + `~/.handoff` 共享目录，任何工具可实现、可审计、可互操作（开放协议的资格由独立第二实现背书，见[质量与证据](#质量与证据)）。已互通：[dsh-chat-import](https://github.com/Nwflower/dsh-chat-import)（INTERCHANGE v1 双向转换互验）。你的工具若读写同一目录或卡片格式，欢迎开 issue 登记互通。

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 权限范围：写 `~/.handoff/`（`HANDOFF_HOME` 可覆盖）、读 git 状态、只读九家 agent 的本地会话库（zcode 与 cursor 走 sqlite readonly，随开随关；`HANDOFF_ROOT_<家>` 可覆盖各家根路径）。cursor 只导入支持的 transcript / store 记录，grok 只读可见 updates.jsonl 流（永不读 chat_history.jsonl 原始模型上下文），gemini 只读本地 chats/ 会话文件。不访问网络，不复活外部进程，不回放历史工具调用，原文不进卡片。

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · 开发：```bash
pnpm install       # @deepseek-ai/* 走 npm registry；@agent-handoff/* 走 file: 链接
npm run typecheck
npm test           # node:test + tsx
npm run build      # tsdown → lib/（@agent-handoff/core + readers 内联打包）

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Introduction：

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · dsh-takeover · Session Takeover：**Take over any agent's half-finished work and keep going — read-only session pull from nine CLIs, one-click check-in, pickup on start. Sessions and memory both hand over.**

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cold777/dsh-takeover)

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Install (30 seconds)：**npm package name** (paste it in the "Plugins → Add plugin" dialog; CN users resolve via npmmirror automatically):

```
@cold777/dsh-takeover
```

**CLI (GitHub source, works right now):**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:IKEASven69/dsh-takeover
```

**Settings card:** DSH Settings → Plugins → Add plugin → paste `github:IKEASven69/dsh-takeover`

**Let your agent install it** — send this to your DSH agent verbatim:

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Install (30 seconds)：> Please install the dsh-takeover plugin: run `dsh plugin --profile web add github:IKEASven69/dsh-takeover`. When it finishes, restart the DSH web app, confirm dsh-takeover is enabled under Settings → Plugins, then report the result back to me.

Works out of the box (built artifacts are committed — no local toolchain). Pin a release: `github:IKEASven69/dsh-takeover#v0.1.0`. Requires DSH ≥0.2.0-rc.2 and Node ≥22.

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · First 30 seconds：| You want to | Say / type | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| Take over a foreign session | `/resume-claude` (or plain words: "take over the latest Claude Code session") | Read-only pull → six-section card injected into the live turn → the model continues |
| Hand the current session off | `/handoff` | Current session distilled into a protocol card, uncommitted changes attached as a patch |
| Pick up on start | `/inbox` | List pending cards → verify and sign for one → context injected, keep working |
| Browse before deciding | Click the "Relay" chip next to the composer | Workstation opens: browse nine agents' recent sessions, one-click takeover / check-out, memory snapshot |
| Hand memory over too | Workstation → Memory snapshot → select and pack | CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md and friends packed into a card; the receiver absorbs them per its "suggested loads" |

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · How it works (60 seconds)：**The filesystem is the bus.** One card per `.md` file in `~/.handoff/pending/`: writing is delivery, pickup moves it to `archived/` (rolling 50 kept; consume-and-archive, a second pickup of the same id errors).

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · How it works (60 seconds)：**A card = Markdown + YAML frontmatter + six body sections** (goal / files involved / how far it got / what's left / where it stopped / reader warnings), carrying a four-state evidence ledger (CURRENT_OBSERVED / HISTORY_REPORTED / MISMATCH / UNAVAILABLE) — historical claims never masquerade as present fact. Uncommitted changes in a git repo are attached as a patch automatically (refused above 512KB, never truncated).

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · How it works (60 seconds)：**Trust lives in the file.** First push generates a bus signing key; cards carry machine signatures; pickup rules three ways — `ok / tampered / no-key`. Tampering is detectable, cross-trust-domain never false-positives.

**Read-only promise.** No writes to any foreign agent's session store, no network access, no replaying historical tool calls; raw text never enters the card — only pointers.

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Tools & commands reference：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `foreign_session_read` | Read-only pull across nine agents. `action=list` lists candidates (title/time/turns); `action=show` resolves a reference (empty/`latest`, id, prefix, path, title keyword — ambiguity returns candidates, never guesses) into a structured summary: title, turns, first user message, recent progress, top-15 files, six-section card material. Raw turns only when `limit` is passed explicitly; probe/parse failures return `{ ok: false, error }` instead of throwing |
| `handoff_push` | Check the current session out as a protocol card. Sections left empty are deterministically backfilled from the session event stream (no LLM call); uncommitted changes attach as a patch; returns `{ ok, id, path, coverage, patch? }` |
| `handoff_inbox` | `action=list` pending cards; `action=load` picks one up (consume-and-archive, with signature and git-verified MISMATCH / UNAVAILABLE warnings) |
| `handoff_memory` | Memory snapshot. `action=scan` read-only lists each agent's memory files (size/preview); `action=push` packs selections into a card the receiver absorbs via "suggested loads" |

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Tools & commands reference：| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/resume-*` (nine) | Resolve reference → read-only pull → four-state marking (foreign history is untrusted and never overrides current instructions) → six-section card injected into the live turn → ends by asking whether to check the session into the inbox |
| `/handoff` | Distills the current session per the protocol's six rules (four-state ledger, no raw text, artifacts as paths only, redact, suggested-loads section, reverse-anchoring + pruning) and checks it in |
| `/inbox` | Lists pending cards for the user to pick; after pickup the card is injected as HISTORY_REPORTED — verify git state before executing |

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Cross-machine relay：Point `HANDOFF_HOME` at a synced-drive folder or a git repository and the inbox is shared: `handoff_push` on machine A, `/inbox` pickup on machine B. One environment variable, zero code. Cards are readable from any phone's file viewer too.

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Quality & evidence：Relay quality is not vibes — it is numbers, tests, and third-party-checkable proof (methodology and reproduction steps in [eval/README.md](eval/README.md)):

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Quality & evidence：- **Backtest**: 50 real consumed cards — continuation rate 34.7%; cards with ledger marks in the done section continued 50% of the time vs 0% for unmarked ones. End-to-end two-card relay against a real host and model: PASS.
- **Parse regression**: 13 golden files frozen byte-for-byte against a structurally-cloned, anonymized real-session corpus — upstream storage drift turns red before merge.
- **Security**: threat model in [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md); 8 red-team suites in CI — the secret gate covers all six sections, every scalar, and the card's patch diff.
- **Protocol**: `conformance/` executable suite (9 MUST requirements derived from the SPEC); both the reference implementation and an independent second implementation (written from the SPEC alone) conform.
- **Interop**: INTERCHANGE v1 (dsh-chat-import) ↔ handoff: 1 bidirectional conversion, verified by a real import through their plugin v0.26.2.

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Positioning：The "continuable context" need in AI coding splits into three layers: spec tools (spec-kit / OpenSpec and friends) own the **design state**; memory layers (mem0 / Letta / dsh-hippo and friends) own the **preference state**; dsh-takeover owns the **run state** — how far work actually got, where it stopped, which statements are present observations versus secondhand retellings, which machine a card came from. The three layers complement each other.

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Positioning：The one-sentence mechanical distinction: **they do "convert, then natively resume in another CLI", "cross-device sync", "navigation/search", "runtime orchestration", or "task-state transport"; we do in-harness takeover.**

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Protocol adoption：`handoff: 1` is an open protocol: a six-section Markdown card + YAML frontmatter + the `~/.handoff` shared directory — implementable, auditable and interoperable by any tool (the right to call it open is backed by an independent second implementation, see [Quality & evidence](#quality--evidence)). Already interoperating: [dsh-chat-import](https://github.com/Nwflower/dsh-chat-import) (bidirectional conversion verified via INTERCHANGE v1). If your tool reads or writes the same directory or card format, open an issue to register interoperability.

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Permission scope：Writes `~/.handoff/` (override via `HANDOFF_HOME`), reads git status, read-only access to the nine agents' local session stores (zcode and cursor via sqlite readonly, opened on demand; per-agent roots overridable via `HANDOFF_ROOT_<agent>`). cursor imports only supported transcript / store records; grok reads only the visible updates.jsonl stream (never the raw chat_history.jsonl model context); gemini reads only local chats/ session files. No network access, no reviving external processes, no replaying historical tool calls, raw text never enters cards.

@cold777/dsh-takeover README · Development：```bash
pnpm install       # @deepseek-ai/* via npm registry; @agent-handoff/* via file: links
npm run typecheck
npm test           # node:test + tsx
npm run build      # tsdown → lib/ (@agent-handoff/core + readers bundled in)

`@agent-handoff/core` and `@agent-handoff/readers` are unpublished; they are wired via `file:../agent-handoff/packages/*` and bundled into `lib/` at build time.
